subject: [Encord] AI Execs Dinner @ Quince (3* Michelin) 06/05
text:
Hey [NAME],

Hope all is well! Our founders are hosting an exclusive AI roundtable
dinner at the 3-star Michelin restaurant Quince in SF on June 5th with
ChenLi Wang, GP at WndrCo, moderating the discussion -- I was wondering
whether you'd be interested / free to join?

It'll be an intimate event with CxOs, founders, and VPs from Netflix,
Waymo, Dolby, OpenAI, and others - capping the attendance at around 12
people to ensure an engaging, off-the-record discussion.

The dinner will run from 6:30-9:30pm and the focus will be on scaling AI
from theory to impact. We'll dive into questions around translating AI
models into actionable solutions, balancing cutting-edge advancements with
practical results, and identifying the most promising opportunities in the
AI space today.

The evening will be a great chance to network with like minded leaders so
let me know if you're interested, and I can add you to the event invite.
